title: A batch judge call retried after a reply that matched no item counts as one call in the census.phase row
goal: judge_tally counts each model call a batch made, the retry included, so the census.phase row's calls match the calls billed

run:
import collections, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import factdiff as f
items = [{'fact': 'The setting is on by default. [DOC S1]', 'old': 'The setting is on by default.', 'new': 'The setting is on by default.'}]
seen = []
def call(prompt, model, cap):
    seen.append(1)
    v = [] if len(seen) == 1 else [{'n': 1, 'verdict': 'supported', 'sentence': 'The setting is on by default.'}]
    return {'verdicts': v, 'cost_usd': 0.01, 'usage': {}, 'error': ''}
verdicts, calls = f.judge_items(items, size=5, jobs=1, cap_usd=0.1, call=call)
tally = collections.Counter()
f.judge_tally(tally, verdicts, calls)
print('model calls made', len(seen), 'calls tallied', tally['calls'])
sys.exit(0 if tally['calls'] == len(seen) else 1)
